{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load and clean data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders and refunded orders
completed_only = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue'] != 999999.99)]

# Stratify by customer_segment and compute conversion rate within each segment
stratified = completed_only.groupby(['customer_segment', 'channel'])['converted'].mean().unstack(level='channel')

# Compute difference within each segment
stratified['diff'] = stratified['email'] - stratified['paid_search']

# Compute segment sizes for weighting
segment_counts = completed_only.groupby('customer_segment').size()

# Compute weighted average difference
weighted_diff = (stratified['diff'] * segment_counts).sum() / segment_counts.sum()

# Print all required values explicitly, including the returning segment difference
print('Conversion rate (email) - loyal:', stratified.loc['loyal', 'email'])
print('Conversion rate (paid_search) - loyal:', stratified.loc['loyal', 'paid_search'])
print('Difference (email - paid_search) - loyal:', stratified.loc['loyal', 'diff'])

print('Conversion rate (email) - new:', stratified.loc['new', 'email'])
print('Conversion rate (paid_search) - new:', stratified.loc['new', 'paid_search'])
print('Difference (email - paid_search) - new:', stratified.loc['new', 'diff'])

print('Conversion rate (email) - returning:', stratified.loc['returning', 'email'])
print('Conversion rate (paid_search) - returning:', stratified.loc['returning', 'paid_search'])
print('Difference (email - paid_search) - returning:', stratified.loc['returning', 'diff'])

print('Segment counts:', segment_counts.to_dict())
print('Weighted average difference (adjusted):', weighted_diff)"}
